statements.notes:
Not all creatine is created equal. CREATINE DRIVE Black utilizes the most popular, most researched and scientifically proven creatine in a concentrated dose. Science has shown that small, concentrated doses of creatine quickly result in maximum blood plasma levels! Gone are the days of high dosing and loading phases.
The creatine in CREATINE DRIVE Black is produced with a patented manufacturing process guaranteeing the safest, purest and most concentrated creatine monohydrate you can find.
Daily consumption of 1-2 small, concentrated doses of CREATINE DRIVE Black rapidly supplies your muscles with creatine, leading to an increase in muscle mass and greater training capacity with noticeable strength gains.
Use your smart phone to scan this QR code for more information and to see real consumer reviews about this product or visit Nutrex.com.

RECOMMENDED USE FOR ATHLETES UNDER 200 LBS: Mix 1 scoop with 8 oz of water and consume immediately. Take 1 serving daily. No loading phase is required. 
RECOMMENDED USE FOR ATHLETES OVER 200 LBS: Mix 1 scoop with 8 oz of water and consume immediately.  Take 1 serving twice per day. No loading phase is required.
CREATINE DRIVE Black is unflavored and can be easily added to any beverage of your choice.
Allergen Warning: Manufactured on equipment that processes products containing milk, egg, soybeans, fin fish and wheat.
